title: # Currently raspi arm64 kernel fails to boot in scalingstack making it
commit_message:
# Currently raspi arm64 kernel fails to boot in scalingstack making it
# impossible to run ADT dkms tests. Multiple IS tickets are filed to
# get access to scalingstack to investigate failures as well as
# requests to upgrade arm64 scalingstack qemu. kernel-testing already
# unblocked this kernel & NBS has been cleaned up thus it is ready to
# migrate to impish-release.
force-skiptest linux-meta-raspi/5.13.0.1006.12
diff:
diff --git a/ubuntu-release b/ubuntu-release
index fc1ef11..57b9d35 100644
--- a/ubuntu-release
+++ b/ubuntu-release
@@ -11796,3 +11796,11 @@ force-badtest systemd/248.3-1ubuntu1/armhf
 
 # armhf autopkgtest images can't currently use ping, hint for glibc migration
 force-reset-test r-cran-sys/3.4-1/armhf
+
+# Currently raspi arm64 kernel fails to boot in scalingstack making it
+# impossible to run ADT dkms tests. Multiple IS tickets are filed to
+# get access to scalingstack to investigate failures as well as
+# requests to upgrade arm64 scalingstack qemu. kernel-testing already
+# unblocked this kernel & NBS has been cleaned up thus it is ready to
+# migrate to impish-release.
+force-skiptest linux-meta-raspi/5.13.0.1006.12
